title: Upscale applies the factor twice - staged input is pre-scaled 1.5x before upscale_by
description: Upscale op applies the factor TWICE - 1.5x on a 768x1344 source yields 1728x3024 (2.25x). Root is NOT the factor and NOT the workflow: Input_Upscale_Factor has exactly one writer (PromptBoxControls.upscaleFactor, injects the raw 1.5), the sidecars for upscale_013/014/015/016 all record 1.5, node 1657 feeds only MpiGridDimensions.upscale_factor and UltimateSDUpscale.upscale_by, and the user ran the same graph in the ComfyUI browser and got the correct size. The graph is fed the WRONG IMAGE: generationSettings.mediaItems points at Media/.preview-assets/1ed8902c...png which measures 1152x2016, i.e. the 768x1344 source already enlarged 1.5x. 1152x2016 * 1.5 = 1728x3024 exactly. t2i_039's own sidecar reports pixelDimensions 768x1344 and has no previewAssets, so that file is not a full-res twin - it exists only in the content-addressed staging store. All four runs used the same hash, consistent with a deterministic pre-scale of the same source at the same factor. UNPROVEN: which code writes the pre-scaled staged copy. Start there.
